message.text: Legs: double tap Left Shift to autorun. Any movement key, Shift, Space, fire, or raising your weapon stops it. Rebind it under Options > Controls > Others.
Hands: hold O with an item in hands to offer it, or with empty hands to request one. Bind 'open or close pockets' in Controls so others can fill your pockets.
Ears: press N to put earplugs in or take them out. Rebind it under Options > Controls > Others.
Scrawl: find paper and a pen to write a note. Look at a note and hold F to read it.
Tack: pin a note to a wall with a hammer and nail, duct tape, epoxy putty, or a knife. Hold F on a pinned note to read it or take it down.
